authors: C.-J. Lorenzen, K. Niemax, L. R. Pendrill
title: Precise measurements of 39K nS and nD energy levels with an evacuated wavemeter
method: Doppler-free two-photon spectroscopy in a thermionic diode (K vapour ~3.5 mTorr, 208 C) with a cw ring dye laser (Rh6G, 572-614 nm); laser wavelength from an evacuated Michelson wavemeter referenced to a He-Ne laser calibrated against 85Rb 5S-nS lines of Lee et al.; pressure shifts corrected (up to 1 mK at high n); fine structure from Fabry-Perot fringes (resolved to n = 40).
uncertainty: total uncertainty of the energy levels about +-0.0007 cm^-1 (wavelength accuracy 2e-8, +-10 MHz), not given per level; relative scatter around the Ritz fit mostly < 0.3 mK (Fig. 3)
conversion: Energies from '4s 2S1/2 F=2 hyperfine component of the ground state (Table 1 caption); excited-state hfs corrected', energy zero: Table 1 caption: 'relative to the hyperfine ground state component 4 2S1/2 (F = 2), corrected for excited state hfs'. The text sentence 'the energy levels and the ionization limit refer to the centres of gravity' holds for E_i only (see content.energy_reference).

Shifted by 0.0057755 cm^-1 to the ground state hyperfine centre of gravity (3/8 x 461.72 MHz (ground hfs quoted in the text); Table 1 caption states F=2; confirmed by the Table 2 Ritz fits (our metadata)).
caveats: Table 1 values are relative to the 4s F=2 hyperfine level (caption), NOT the centre of gravity: add 3/8 x 461.7197 MHz = 0.0057755 cm^-1 (173.1 MHz) to refer them to the c.o.g. used by E_i, Peper 2019 and RydState. The text sentence claiming c.o.g. applies to E_i only (see content.energy_reference).

NIST ASD (K/nist_asd, RydState nist_data.txt) copies these F=2-referenced values unchanged for nS n>=9 and nD n>=7, while its n<=8 levels (from Thompson 1983, converted to the c.o.g.) and its IE 35009.8140 are c.o.g.: ASD nS/nD n>=9 are therefore ~0.0058 cm^-1 (173 MHz) too low relative to ASD's own ground state and IE.
No per-level uncertainty; global +-0.0007 cm^-1 (mostly absolute calibration, common to all levels).
nD fine structure for n > 30 partially overlapping (only n <= 30 used for the fs fits in the source).
